name: LINDEA SAUNA
description: The Lindea Sauna is a work of art, truly unlike any other. Designed in the European style, it is elegant and chic. Soft edges, a raised deck, full-length benches, and unique adjustable seats are only a few of the features that make the Lindea stand out.  Beautiful heat-treated Aspen enfolds the outside of the sauna, giving a modish contrast to the bright Nordic Spruce within. The tempered glass door and front windows give the sauna an open and inviting feel. Six to eight individuals can sit in the Lindea Sauna comfortably on the extra-wide adjustable benches. The interior is open and pure, a comforting escape, and the fashionable exterior will increase the value of any room in the house. With the luxurious Lindea, you’ll enjoy the traditional sauna experience and a work of art.
